neighbours.label: distributive ' each' after a plural subject ('my students each made ...')
fire: The four sisters each inherited a small field near the river.
Our volunteers each brought a bag of warm clothes.
The three winners each received a medal and a book.
My pottery students each glazed a pair of mugs.
The two brothers each own a boat in the harbor.
These cooks each prepared a different soup for the contest.
The committee members each signed the letter in blue ink.
The children each picked a pumpkin from the patch.
